title: Grimoire bundle (catalog/bundles/<id>.toml)
description: A named, versioned list of asset references. Not an asset kind.

id.description: Identifier, unique across assets and bundles; equals the file stem.

maintainers.description: GitHub logins of the maintainers; at least one.

assets.description: Member assets with version requirements; at least one.

Format.description: Document format version. Grimoire currently reads and writes format 1.

AssetId.description: Asset or bundle identifier: 1-64 characters of [a-z0-9-], no leading, trailing or doubled '-'. Must not start with claude-, anthropic-, anthropics- or cc-plugin-, and must not be 'synced'.

Version.description: A SemVer 2.0.0 version without build metadata, e.g. "1.2.3".

Summary.description: One line, at most 120 characters, no leading or trailing whitespace.

VersionReq.description: A Cargo-style SemVer requirement, e.g. "^1.2", ">=1, <3" or "*".
